check.text: RECORD COMPLETE: 81 CHOICES, 11 FIGHTS REPLAYED AND MATCHED

event.name: A Duelling Ground
event.text: A ring of stakes, a champion inside it, and a crowd that wants blood.

options.label: CHALLENGE THE CHAMPION
options.text: A hard fight, with an elite's spoils: a legendary, then a formation.

options.label: WATCH
options.text: Three members each learn an ability or train one from the champion's form.

notes: A Duelling Ground: challenge the champion.

event.name: The Quartermaster's Wagon
event.text: An army wagon stuck to the axles in mud, its quartermaster red in the face.

options.label: PUSH IT FREE
options.text: Everyone loses 10% of max HP. A formation and a potion, in thanks.

notes: The Quartermaster's Wagon: push it free.

event.name: An Empty Camp
event.text: Someone left in a hurry: the fire is still burning, the bedrolls still laid out.

options.label: MAKE CAMP
options.text: A campfire: rest, focus, raise or train.

options.label: SEARCH THE PACKS
options.text: A potion, a tonic or a phoenix feather, and 20 gold.

notes: An Empty Camp: search the packs.
Room for one more at camp: 3 seats.
Act 2: The Crypt. The Reaper waits at the end.

event.name: A Mana Spring
event.text: A spring gone sour, though a shimmer still clings to the stones around it.

options.label: DRINK DEEP
options.text: Everyone recovers 50% of max MP and loses 10% of max HP.

event.name: A Deserter
event.text: An officer, by the look of the blade at their hip, bleeding from a wound they won't explain.

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you at a third of their HP, knowing two abilities, with a rare piece suited to them.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: They teach yours an officer's drill and walk on: three members each learn an ability or train one.

options.label: TAKE THE BLADE
options.text: A rare piece; they limp off.

event.name: A Field Hospital
event.text: A hospital overrun with wounded. The surgeon looks up: "You. Hands. Now."

options.label: HELP OUT
options.text: Everyone loses 15% of max MP. A potion and a phoenix feather, from the stores.

event.name: A Blood Shrine
event.text: An altar, a bowl, and something glinting under the stone. The shrine wants blood.

options.label: OFFER BLOOD
options.text: Everyone loses 20% of max HP. A rare piece.

notes: the Hexer joins at the fire.

event.name: The War Table
event.text: A command tent with one tired sentry dozing at the flap.

options.label: SLIP IN
options.text: A formation. The sentry wakes and calls the guard: a fight.

notes.text: Act 1: The Old Road. The Packmaster waits at the end.
A Duelling Ground: challenge the champion.
The Quartermaster's Wagon: push it free.
An Empty Camp: search the packs.
Room for one more at camp: 3 seats.
Act 2: The Crypt. The Reaper waits at the end.
the Hexer joins at the fire.
